rationale: Correct Yusen Terminals' ownership history without treating Ocean Network Express' 2023 purchase as Macquarie's exit. ONE closed the acquisition of NYK's 51% interest on November 6, 2023 while Macquarie Infrastructure Partners III retained 49%. Transaction counsel later disclosed a separate US$550 million sale of Macquarie's 49% Bluefin interest, and YTI's current company-controlled profile identifies the business as wholly owned by ONE. The exact later buyer vehicle and closing date are not publicly disclosed, so the database records the verified realized state without inventing a date.

afterImage.name: Yusen Terminals LLC
afterImage.description: Yusen Terminals LLC operates a marine container terminal at the Port of Los Angeles on Terminal Island. Its infrastructure includes berths, cargo-handling cranes, storage yards, gate systems, on-dock rail and shore-power facilities serving container lines and North American import and export supply chains. Ocean Network Express acquired NYK's 51% interest in 2023 and subsequently became the terminal's sole owner after Macquarie Infrastructure Partners III sold its separate 49% interest for US$550 million. The exact closing date and buyer vehicle for Macquarie's later sale were not publicly disclosed.
